_doc: Each entry: {id, quote, area, displayName (string or null for anonymous), verified (bool), date}. Set displayName=null for anonymous; otherwise it appears with the area, e.g. 'James, SE17'. Set verified=true after you've checked the postcode/proof-of-address. Site renders all entries in order.

entries.quote: I've lived on Walworth Road for eleven years. My nearest station is Elephant — fifteen minutes if I walk fast, twenty-five with a buggy. Every other inner-London neighbourhood I've lived in had a tube on the doorstep. We're not asking for special treatment. We're asking for what zone 1 normally gets.

I work shifts at King's College Hospital. Denmark Hill is fine — when I can get there. From Camberwell Green at 5am there's no bus that gets me in on time. A reopened Camberwell station would change my life. The platforms are literally still there.

We bought here when our son was born because schools and the park are great. Three years later we've spent a small fortune on Lime hires and Ubers because moving with kids on the bus along Walworth Road is a daily wrestle. The Bakerloo extension is welcome. But it doesn't help us — Burgess Park is fifteen minutes away. Reopen Walworth Road first.
